notes: Weapon cards can no longer display Mk badges.
Market stock patch now installs a MutationObserver that identifies rendered weapon cards by their item IDs and physically removes any .item-mk node from those cards.
The runtime guard works even if an older cached Market template still emits Mk markup.
World Market macro patching still omits Mk markup for weapons at the source, so the DOM guard is a defensive fallback rather than the primary presentation.
Finished gun sheets remain free of mk, rating, tier, ratingLabel, and marketTier metadata.
